title: Portable appliance setup — quick jots
content:
(scratchpad) portable appliance setup — quick jots

Context: Did a one-off deploy at customer site (small appliance rack, single-host config) — this is my on-the-fly log to hand to night shift. Keep terse.

Today summary:
- Arrived 09:30 local. Customer: FinHealth (PCI scope).
- Rack: 1U appliance (serial AP-2034). OS image applied from USB thumb (redwood-onprem-2025.02.img).
- Network: physical NIC mapping changed vs runbook (eth0 -> management VLAN 10, eth1 -> data VLAN 42). Confirmed cabling labels were swapped.

Immediate checklist (minimal, actionable):
1) Confirm management IP set to 10.10.10.23/24 (gateway 10.10.10.1).
   - sudo nmcli connection show -> confirmed profile "mgmt-wired" active.
   - curl -sS http://10.10.10.23:8080/health -> 200 OK but /metrics empty (need redis started).
2) Verify KMS integration (customer uses AWS KMS via VPC endpoint).
   - aws-kms-agent.service is inactive. systemctl start aws-kms-agent -> failed with timeout waiting for VPC endpoint resolution.
   - Note: customer endpoint uses private DNS name kms-fh-prod.local, resolver configured via DHCP option set but VM DNS cache not refreshed. Running: resolvectl flush-caches then systemctl restart aws-kms-agent -> now agent started and keys listable.
3) Token/key material: initial admin key created and stored in vault path "secret/appliance/finhealth/initial_admin". I exported the public key to S3 (s3://redwood-field-uploads/finhealth/keys/).
4) License: appliance license applied via /opt/redwood/bin/apply-license -f /tmp/license-finhealth.pem -> OK.

Open blockers / gotchas:
- Customer proxy prevents outbound access to model catalog; we used a saved model bundle (redwood-edge-v1.9.tar) loaded locally. Need to follow up with networking team on proxy whitelist entry (ticket INFR-4321).
- NTP was set to local stratum incorrectly (customer had internal NTP pool that leaps occasionally). I pointed appliance to pool.ntp.org as temporary; recommend customer approve internal NTP in change window.
- Autoscaling config in console shows dedicated capacity disabled for this customer; they expected burst capacity option. Raise DEPLOY-987 for account-level setting.

Quick commands I ran (save time next shift):
- image write: dd if=redwood-onprem-2025.02.img of=/dev/sdb bs=4M status=progress && sync
- systemctl restart redis && journalctl -u redis -n 100 --no-pager
- resolvectl flush-caches && systemctl restart aws-kms-agent && journalctl -u aws-kms-agent -n 80
- /opt/redwood/bin/setup-network --if eth1 --vlan 42 --ip 10.20.42.11/24 --gw 10.20.42.1

Hand-off items for night shift / next engineer:
- Verify model bundle integrity: sha256sum redwood-edge-v1.9.tar -> expected: 8f3a9b... (I placed checksum in /tmp/model-checksum.txt).
- Re-run integration test suite: /opt/redwood/bin/run-smoke-tests --suite quick-edge. There are two flaky tests (chat-stream and kv-cache) flagged in test output; see test logs at /var/log/redwood/tests/latest.log.
- Confirm KMS automatic restart on boot: enable aws-kms-agent.service (systemctl enable aws-kms-agent) and test reboot. I didn't reboot after fixing DNS.
- Reach out to customer network lead (Anya M.) tomorrow to schedule proxy whitelist change and NTP approval. Contact: anya.m@finhealth.com, phone +1-415-555-0199.

Notes to self / things to add to runbook:
- Add step to clear systemd-resolved cache when using DHCP-provisioned private DNS names (common with customer KMS setups).
- Add a diagnostic command: nmcli -f GENERAL,IP4.ADDRESS,STATE device show eth0
- Consider including an offline model bundle in the appliance image (if customer certifies). Saves time when proxy blocks catalog.

Unresolved questions:
- Customer asked about audit log retention period — current appliance default = 30 days. They may need 365. Ticketing to compliance team?
- Confirm whether appliance should auto-register with customer SAML IdP (they supplied metadata but asked for consult). Put on schedule for next week.

Misc tiny reminders:
- Bring USB-C to serial cable for console next time (forgot it at home).
- Label spare power cable and leave with ops team.

Timestamped entries:
- 09:40 -> image flashed; smoke tests initially failing (redis).
- 10:12 -> found swapped patch panel labels (eth1/eth0).
- 10:47 -> KMS DNS cache flush fixed aws-kms-agent.
- 11:28 -> model bundle loaded and license applied.

End of notes. Keep this doc in users area; will copy into shared_drives/engineering/private-deployments/handovers after edits.

-- Anika (on-call field)
